# Chang Diving Center
> Dive school and scuba shop on Koh Chang, Thailand (Klong Prao Beach). SDI/TDI 5* Instructor Training Facility (ITF); also PADI courses. Day trips, wreck diving (HTMS Chang), snorkeling, and gear — since 2005. Languages: English (`/en/`), German (`/de/`), Thai (`/th/`).

Prefer language-prefixed URLs. Default / English canonical hub: `/en/`. Contact: +66 894-013-927. Book online: `/en/book/` (also `/de/book/`, `/th/book/`) — one form can mix different activities for 2–4 people on the same start date. Site search (noindex utility): `/en/search/`, `/de/search/`, `/th/search/`. Sitemap: https://changdiving.com/sitemap.xml

## Primary
- [English home](https://changdiving.com/en/): Main English landing page
- [German home](https://changdiving.com/de/): German landing page
- [Thai home](https://changdiving.com/th/): Thai landing page
- [Book online (EN)](https://changdiving.com/en/book/): Request a booking — courses, fun dives, try dive, snorkel; mixed activities OK
- [Prices (EN)](https://changdiving.com/en/prices/): Course and trip prices with “Book now” links into the form
- [Courses (EN)](https://changdiving.com/en/courses/): Dive course catalog
- [Day trips (EN)](https://changdiving.com/en/day-trips/): Fun dives, try dive, snorkeling
- [Dive sites (EN)](https://changdiving.com/en/dive-sites/): Koh Chang dive sites including HTMS Chang wreck
- [HTMS Chang wreck](https://changdiving.com/en/dive-sites/htms-chang-wreck/): Flagship wreck dive site off Koh Chang
- [Contact (EN)](https://changdiving.com/en/contact/): Phone, WhatsApp, location (Klong Prao Beach)
- [About (EN)](https://changdiving.com/en/about/): Center background and credentials

## Popular courses
- [Open Water Diver](https://changdiving.com/en/courses/open-water-diver/): Beginner certification (≈3 days)
- [OWD + Advanced package](https://changdiving.com/en/courses/open-advanced-package/): Open Water + Advanced combo
- [Advanced Diver](https://changdiving.com/en/courses/advanced/): Next step after Open Water
- [Deep, Wreck & Nitrox](https://changdiving.com/en/courses/deep-wreck-nitrox/): Specialty package on HTMS Chang
- [Rescue Diver](https://changdiving.com/en/courses/rescue-diver/): Rescue training
- [Divemaster](https://changdiving.com/en/courses/divemaster/): Professional pathway

## Technical diving
- [Technical courses (EN)](https://changdiving.com/en/courses/technical-diving-courses/): TDI pathway — intro to tech through advanced wreck
- [Tech package](https://changdiving.com/en/courses/tech-package/): Combined technical training package
- [Intro to Tech](https://changdiving.com/en/courses/intro-to-tech/): First step into decompression / tech diving

## Day trips
- [Fun dives](https://changdiving.com/en/day-trips/fun-dives/): Certified divers — boat day trips
- [Try dive / Discover Scuba](https://changdiving.com/en/day-trips/try-dive/): First scuba experience without certification
- [Snorkeling](https://changdiving.com/en/day-trips/snorkeling/): Snorkel day trips (same boats as divers)
